Question: How many palindromes (arrangements reading the same forward as backward) of 2 letters or more, containing the letter M, can be formed by rearranging any subset of the letters MISSISSIPPI?

Options: 
A. 102
B. 2012
C. 86
D. 97
E. 72
F. 128
G. 55
H. 89
I. 110
J. 66
